items.title: Bill Kirchner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2021
items.q: including Manny Albam and Bob Brookmeyer and Bill Holman and others

ctx.x: He did that very thing. He commissioned a bunch of great arrangers to do charts on “All of Me” including Manny Albam and Bob Brookmeyer and Bill Holman and others. And they all came up with different slants on it, some of them outrageously outside, like Brookmeyer. So it’s interesting that you should mention that, and pick that particular tune, because indeed it’s been done for precisely the reason that you’re talking about. Anyway to try to answer your question, I guess I would begin by asking about the band…
I would have been so happy if that had been me because I dearly love a shuffle.
